# Planted bugs of orgmachine (scripts/go-mutants.sh org/orgmachine/testdata/mutants.txt,
# make test-go-mutants), in the format of
# orgpki's testdata/mutants.txt. Models: relay spec/proverif/e2ee_tcp_org.pv
# (the client's name and check, the service's group) and spec/enrol/Enrol.tla
# (no-expiry-timer: NoExpiredSession; no-cut-on-update and reload-skips-crl:
# RevocationBound); spec/AuditLog.tla (the audit-* lines: recover-live,
# no-recovery, recover-no-log-check, rotate-unacked, rotate-all,
# rotate-drops-open).
